notes: §9.7.1: "Inherent methods are written `impl Type:`. A trait implementation is written **`impl Type as Trait:`** (DR-10)." §21.3 K0919: "`impl Show for Money:` | `impl Money as Show:` (DR-10)". The Rust-style `for` form is detected in its obvious syntactic position. The Arabic and Franco files put the same hazard back with their own `impl`/`for` keywords (`نفذ Show لكل Money:`, `naffez Show lekol Money:`).
